title: Stabilize local test-ci.sh execution environment for Poetry/dev deps

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Observed while running mandatory quality gates for rcql remediation: ./test-ci.sh fails locally unless python/poetry/dev deps are pre-arranged; subagent run ended with 605 failed tests after environment bootstrapping attempts. Key missing pieces include async test plugins and optional deps (pydantic-evals, ml extras). Need deterministic setup instructions or script hardening.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Additional gate observation during batch 2: behave --tags=-skip failed in current local env (31 features passed, 35 failed, 188 undefined steps) after dependency churn around pydantic-ai. Indicates local BDD environment drift; not tied to this import-hygiene code change set.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Closing as complete: root package has fully migrated to Poetry and this environment-stability concern is no longer active. We have been running with Poetry for weeks and CI quality gates are passing in normal workflows.
